[EXPERIMENTAL] Remove a policy exception

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Remove a policy exception.

Removes an active policy exception, so the violations it exempted fail operations again.
Pulumi Cloud keeps the removed exception for auditing.
You will be prompted to confirm unless --yes is passed.

```
pulumi policy exception remove <exception-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  pulumi policy exception remove EXC-12
  pulumi policy exception remove EXC-12 --yes
```

## Options

```
  -h, --help            help for remove
      --org string      The organization that owns the exception
      --output string   Output format. Supported values are: default and json (default "default")
  -y, --yes             Skip confirmation prompts
```
